retires: ctest:Engine type label services expose live canonical scalars
oracle: The case asserted the addresses of the registry tables' `labels` carrier (`&_railtypes[i].label`, `&_roadtypes[i].label`) and that a lookup read a label C++ wrote in place. #1064 part 2 (decision 2) deletes the carrier: `GetRailTypeByLabel` and `GetRoadTypeByLabel` read each element's label through `RailTypeInfoRef` and `RoadTypeInfoRef`. The observation that a lookup sees a label C++ wrote directly, the first and last element, a missing label and an exact label before an alternate, is `DefinitionLiveLabels` in `tools/simulation/engine-types-console.inc`, compared with the unchanged original 15.3 by the default scenario.
